bio.text: Alexander Kolodin, a Republican, represents District 3 in the Arizona House of Representatives and is the Republican nominee for Arizona Secretary of State in 2026.
He took office in the House in January 2023.
AZFamily reports that Kolodin was born in Chandler and won the July 2026 Republican primary for Secretary of State over former Arizona GOP chair Gina Swoboda.
Kolodin earned a degree from Georgetown University and a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, founded the Kolodin Law Group, and has worked as an attorney.

sources.title: Arizona secretary of state race reignites fight over election rules
